title: Identity verification keeps failing
description: User submitted documents for verification but received rejection without clear reason. Frustrated, needs to know what went wrong and how to resubmit correctly.

title: Verification pending for days
description: User completed verification 3 days ago, account still shows pending status. Can't access full features. Wants timeline or way to expedite.

title: Card stopped working while traveling
description: User is traveling in Thailand, card suddenly declined. Haven't changed settings. Need to know if card was frozen or if it's a merchant issue.

title: Can't find virtual card option
description: User wants to use virtual card for online safety but can't find where to generate one in the app.

title: Apple Pay setup fails
description: User tries to add Revolut card to Apple Pay but gets error message. Card works for regular purchases.

title: Transfer stuck in pending status
description: User sent money to friend 2 days ago, still showing pending. Neither side received or sent. Need to understand delay and how to cancel if needed.

title: Sent money to wrong person
description: User accidentally sent EUR500 to wrong phone number. Recipient hasn't accepted. Wants to know if they can cancel or reverse.

title: SWIFT transfer requests IBAN/BIC
description: User needs to make international transfer via SWIFT. Can't find Revolut IBAN or BIC code in the app.

title: Hit instant transfer limit
description: User needs instant transfer but got message about limit. Wants to know what the limit is and when it resets.

title: See charge I don't recognize
description: User sees transaction in history they don't remember making. Worried about fraud. Wants to dispute the charge.

title: Lost card, need to freeze immediately
description: User lost physical card while out. Needs to freeze it now before someone finds it.

title: Got notification about suspicious activity
description: User received push notification about suspicious activity but no other details. Worried account was compromised.

title: Charged unexpected ATM fee
description: User withdrew cash abroad and got hit with fee they didn't expect. Wants to understand fee structure.
User sees exchange rate in app that differs from Google/Reuters. Wants to understand if Revolut adds markup.

title: Weekend transfer fee applied
description: User made transfer on Saturday and was charged fee. Doesn't understand why weekend matters.

title: Can't buy crypto, error message
description: User tries to buy Bitcoin but gets generic error. Has sufficient balance. Needs to know what's blocking the purchase.

title: Crypto withdrawal taking too long
description: User sent crypto to external wallet 12 hours ago, still pending. Worried it's lost.

title: Hit crypto trading limit
description: User received message about reaching crypto limit. Wants to know what the limit is and if it can be increased.

title: Can't cancel recurring payment
description: User set up recurring payment to gym, wants to cancel but can't find option in app.

title: Charged for cancelled subscription
description: User cancelled Netflix subscription but still got charged this month. Wants refund and to ensure it doesn't recur.

title: Received account limit message
description: User can't top up more money due to account limit. Wants to know the limit and how to increase it.

title: Large payment declined without reason
description: User tried to make significant purchase (card payment), was declined. Has sufficient balance. No explanation given.

title: Can't top up more today
description: User needs to add more funds today but hit limit. Wants to know when it resets and if there's workaround.

title: Want joint account but not available
description: User wants to share account with spouse but Revolut doesn't offer it. Looking for alternatives.

title: Difference between personal and business account
description: User has freelance income growing. Wants to know when to upgrade to business account and what changes.
